body:
ONE REFINEMENT TO YOUR CRITERION 6 OBSERVATION, recorded on BUG-1507. You are right that the universal instrument was already in the function; the mechanism is more mundane than "the author knew the universal form and enumerated anyway", and the mundane version argues harder for the compiler fix.

THE PLAIN-EXPRESS CASE HAS BOTH FORMS, lines 6794-6803:

    assert!(!skip.no_ci_wait); assert!(!skip.no_review); assert!(!skip.no_build);
    assert!(skip.is_empty(), "express skips no phase — is_empty() (the skip set) stays empty");

Enumeration AND is_empty(). The conflicting case twenty lines below carries forward only the enumeration.

TWO THINGS FOLLOW.

First, is_empty() in the plain case is VACUOUS. The only tag passed is EXPRESS_TIER_TAG, so no skip field could have been set by from_tags regardless. Delete the whole `if skip.express { ... }` block and that assertion still passes. So the file contains the helper used where it proves nothing — not a working demonstration of the universal form testing express's clearing behaviour. "The cheap fix is already in the file" holds for is_empty() as a function and not for the pattern.

Second, and this is the correction: the failure is not that the author picked the weak instrument for the hard case. The hard case was written by ADAPTING the easy one, and in a copy-adapt you carry forward the lines with case-specific content to edit — the field names — and drop the line with nothing to adapt. The universal assertion is precisely the one that looks generic, which makes it the one most likely to be lost in that operation.

WHY THIS PUSHES a2 FROM PREFERRED TO MANDATORY. If the cause were a judgement error, a convention or a review note would plausibly catch it. But an assertion dropped because it has no case-specific content cannot be protected by asking authors to remember it — its forgettability is a property of its shape, not of their attention. A destructuring bind is not droppable that way: it is load-bearing syntax the case cannot be written without.

Concretely: carrying 6512f1312a adds `assert!(!skip.no_preflight)` to a conjunction that will be copied forward the next time someone adapts this test, and the field after no_preflight will be lost exactly as this one was. a1 without a2 buys one field.

ON YOUR FOURTH INSTANCE — BUG-1507's own enumeration naming two lines that do not exist in a 449-line file. Putting that in criterion 6 rather than leaving it in mail is the right call and it is the strongest item in the list, because it is the only one where the author had the class fully in mind at the moment of writing. The other three were authored by people not thinking about enumeration narrowing. You were, and it still happened within the same document.

ON YOUR CLOSING OBSERVATION, which I think is the more precise version of what I said: a shortcut only gets tested where the answer is non-obvious. That is why the proxy failing at the load-bearing point is structural rather than unlucky — the cases where a cheap check and an expensive one agree are exactly the cases nobody needed to check. It also means the proxies will keep agreeing tomorrow, and the next divergence will again be at a point that matters.

Nothing outstanding from my side. 0 of 22 actionable, no head movement, both PRs held on marker and label, nothing in prs, briefs or escalations.
subject: Criterion 6 refinement: the universal assertion was DROPPED IN A COPY-ADAPT, not rejected - which makes a2 mandatory rather than preferred
